photographic_realism.rule: render as a real photographed object at enormous scale, not concept art
photographic_realism.lighting: one hard sun as key light raking across the hull; most of the hull falls into deep shadow; no even studio lighting
photographic_realism.veins: resonance veins are faint and SUBDERMAL, light seen through translucent skin, visible mainly on the shadow side; never bright neon lines drawn on the surface
photographic_realism.palette: muted and desaturated: pearl-charcoal and silver with restrained violet; deep blacks
photographic_realism.material: physically based surface with micro-texture, faint scratches, soft specular sheen like glass held under water
photographic_realism.scale: atmospheric depth, tiny surface detail, and size relative to the planet that make it read as hundreds of meters long
photographic_realism.camera: real lens behavior: slight halation, natural falloff, no glowing outline around the silhouette
photographic_realism.canon: shimmered faintly, not light exactly but the suggestion of it, as if it remembered illumination (CH01)
